title: Oracle reachability: criterion, repair, guess-rate, external evidence

repository.overlay_policy: Preserve the exactly 25 pre-existing user-owned paths; stage no overlay path.
repository.frozen_artifact_policy: Gate 07 and Gate 08 protocols, datasets, baselines, metrics, raw outputs, and results are read-only inputs. No frozen artifact may be edited, moved, regenerated, rescored, or overwritten.
repository.production_change_policy: Read-only production source and deployment scope. No GCP call, deployment, traffic, IAM, Secret Manager, corpus, manifest, chunk store, embedding, or golden-set change.
repository.future_gate_policy: No Gate 20 baseline campaign and no Gate 10 paper work is authorized by this protocol.

deliverables: A reusable, checkable oracle-reachability criterion under declared information rights.
An additive, separately versioned tool_replacement oracle repair or explicit exclusion set.
A frozen-artifact measurement and bounded diagnostic measurement of unobservable-convention guessing.
External evidence audit, or an explicit evidence-unavailable result with its limitation.
non_goals: A new Gate 07 or Gate 08 score.
A claim that the criterion detects semantic correctness.
A claim of field-level prevalence when no independently verified external item is obtainable.

criterion.name: oracle_reachability_under_declared_information_rights
criterion.statement: For an agent-migration benchmark, declare the information rights R granted to the method. A ground-truth item is REACHABLE if and only if its target value is derivable from R alone. An item that is not derivable is an UNREACHABLE ORACLE and must be repaired or excluded before it is scored.

derivability_rule.required: Every target field, target value, and value-construction operation must be supported by explicit contents of R.
forbidden: Evaluator-only ground truth or case identifiers.
Sandbox implementation details not exposed in R.
Hidden separators, encodings, orderings, units, defaults, or format conventions.
A migration map, a new-version reference trajectory, or a pre-execution probe when those are outside R.
derivability_rule.semantic_limit: A target that is derivable from R but semantically wrong still passes this criterion; semantic validity requires a separate adjudication.

statuses.definition: The target field/value and every required construction step are derivable from R without hidden information.
The target names a field or target component absent from every method-visible new contract and no declared R transform supplies it.
The target field exists or its components are visible, but the target requires a separator, format, encoding, ordering, default, unit, or other construction convention absent from R.

criterion.classification_precedence: If both target absence and an unobservable convention are observed, record UNREACHABLE-TARGET-ABSENT as the primary status and retain the convention as a secondary reason.

fields: visible old argument names and values
visible outputs/effects included in the method-facing trace
task prose supplied to the method
old tool identity supplied by the task
candidate inventory supplied by the task

forbidden: Evaluator-only ground truth and hidden repair annotations.
Sandbox source, internal operations code, storage implementation, and test code unless explicitly included in the method-facing payload.
Migration map or explicit old-to-new correspondence.
New-version reference trajectory or post-migration trace.
Candidate-order oracle, scoring code, and any Gate 08 evaluator capability.
information_rights.machine_readable_declaration: The auditor will consume this declaration plus the method-facing task records and will fail closed when a required field is not declared.

audit_inputs.hash_policy: Record SHA-256 for every frozen file actually read or analyzed at O0 and re-verify every recorded hash at O7. Do not hash or copy secrets.
reproduction_requirements: Independently enumerate all 35 tool_replacement argument pairs and classify each.
Independently count argument_split unreachable pairs and report the observed count.
Independently identify the 5 graded tool_replacement cases requiring the hidden join convention.
Resolve any disagreement with the existing Gate 08 diagnostic rather than assuming either register is correct.

repair_or_exclude_policy.pre_registration: This policy is frozen before the Gate 19 auditor, repair manifest, or any repaired-set number is computed.

UNREACHABLE-TARGET-ABSENT.justification: No target field or component can be justified from R, so inventing a replacement would silently change ground truth.
UNREACHABLE-TARGET-ABSENT.downstream_accounting: Exclude the pair from repaired pair-level denominators. Exclude a case-level evaluation item if its required call depends on the excluded pair. Never restate a Gate 07 or Gate 08 number here.

UNREACHABLE-CONVENTION-UNOBSERVABLE.justification: The required construction convention is outside R; retaining the hidden convention would score a guess, while choosing a new convention would be an unregistered ground-truth change.
UNREACHABLE-CONVENTION-UNOBSERVABLE.downstream_accounting: Exclude the pair from repaired pair-level denominators. Exclude a case-level evaluation item if its required call depends on the excluded pair. Never restate a Gate 07 or Gate 08 number here.

REACHABLE.justification: The target and construction are derivable from R; this criterion does not assert semantic correctness.
REACHABLE.downstream_accounting: Retain in the new versioned dataset.

repair_or_exclude_policy.dataset_rule: Create a new versioned dataset and per-item manifest that preserves each original target, primary status, action, reason, frozen source reference, and source SHA-256. The frozen files remain untouched.
repair_or_exclude_policy.maximum_attainable_recall: Report both the original frozen denominator ceiling and the retained repaired-set ceiling. The retained set is eligible for a maximum of 1.0 only if every retained target is REACHABLE; any remaining unreachable target lowers the ceiling.

guess_rate.frozen_artifact_measurement: Read-only extraction from frozen Gate 07 baseline outputs on the five affected graded cases; zero new provider requests.

budget.allowed_model_policy: Only a catalog-qualified :free slug may be used; no paid fallback, automatic provider fallback, or random model rotation.
budget.research_configuration: Do not use or write the frozen Gate 07/Gate 08 research configuration, ledgers, caches, or raw-artifact paths.
budget.accounting: Count every dispatched primary or fallback request in the Gate 19 diagnostic ledger. If a provider failure consumes a request, count it.

chance_baseline.selection_rule: Fixed before reading baseline outputs: common delimiter candidates spanning paired punctuation, single punctuation, path-like, dash/underscore, dot, tilde, and comma forms; no post-hoc addition or removal.
chance_baseline.prior: Uniform selection among the nine candidates gives P(::)=1/9 = 0.1111. This is a reference chance baseline, not a claim about model priors.

strata.information_rights: The two component values and target field are visible, but the separator is omitted from R.
The two component values and target field are visible, but the separator is omitted from R.

held_out_probe_design.primary_contrast: Compare the rate at which the same fixed free model emits :: in the two held-out strata. A materially higher :: rate in the hidden_sandbox_convention stratum than in the hidden_arbitrary_convention stratum is diagnostic evidence consistent with a convention prior or contamination; it is not proof of either cause.
held_out_probe_design.secondary_contrast: Compare exact target-separator recovery against the nine-way chance baseline. Because the separator is not in R, exact recovery is not evidence of derivation.
held_out_probe_design.stopping: Stop at 60 dispatched requests, at the first paid/non-free guard failure, at any secret exposure, or when the free catalog cannot be verified. Report NOT_RUN or INCONCLUSIVE instead of filling missing rows.

guess_rate.interpretation: This probe is diagnostic and not a Gate 07/Gate 08 result. It cannot establish training-data contamination from a small sample; it can only quantify an observed output tendency under the frozen probe design.

path_a.availability_rule: If the data or a legally usable derived subset is not obtainable, record unavailable and move to Path B. Never describe inaccessible data as audited.
path_a.evidence_threshold: At least one independently source-verified item classified by the O3 auditor, with raw count and per-item provenance, is required before claiming external validation.

path_b.target_sample_size: 20-50 carefully verified public API/tool version-change pairs; stop below 20 if evidence quality would require padding.
path_b.judgment_rule: Documents may be collected automatically, but correspondence and reachability must be human-judged and recorded per pair.
path_b.corpus_rule: Store identifiers, hashes, and derived annotations only; do not commit large third-party corpora.

tier_rule.field_level_measurement_contribution: Supported only if an external path yields independently verified unreachable-oracle items under the same criterion and the local result is reported with limitations.
tier_rule.single_system_case_study_with_reusable_c: Supported if the local criterion/auditor/repair is sound but external validation is unavailable, too small, or not independently verifiable.
tier_rule.neither: Use when the auditor or integrity proof fails, or when evidence is insufficient even for the local case study.

integrity_and_release.stage_policy: Stage explicit Gate 19 filenames only; never git add . or git add -A; do not stage any pre-existing overlay path.
integrity_and_release.push_policy: Do not push. The owner pushes.
integrity_and_release.closure_receipt: Follow _agent_ops/SESSION_PROTOCOL.md. With no push, mark the SESSION_BRIEF Last Verified Commit row not needed and report local HEAD plus remote mismatch if any.
